quarterly_data.quarter: Huawei press release: Reshaping Network Value for New Growth in the AI Era (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President of Huawei Optical Business Product Line Bob Chen (keynote at the Network X 2026 WBBA Broadband Development Congress): large AI models now feature nearly 10 trillion parameters and token consumption has surged nearly 50-fold over the past year; with the rise of AI the number of AIDCs has grown nearly 10-fold and traffic volume is no longer determined by population but by computing power, so network architecture must shift from administrative-region-centered to AIDC-centered networks (Core, Regional and Edge DCs with direct one-hop mesh connections and deterministic 1-5-20 ms latency circles). He cited Zhongwei, China, now one of China's eight national computing hubs, whose intelligent computing traffic accounts for over 10% of the country's total bandwidth, against only about 0.1% of China's total traffic in the past.
quarterly_data.figure: number of AIDCs grown nearly 10-fold; token consumption up nearly 50-fold over the past year
